description: The CONCEPTS the agent holds to understand that navigation has several modes (frontier_seek / mover_avoid / pocket_escape) and to actively choose between them by shape (winner-take-all over situation-driven activations) + the NavMode competitor nodes. The CHOOSING rules (activation -> Argmax winner -> mode-gated select) live in grid_navigation.

attrs.name: navigation_mode
attrs.definition: a policy for choosing the avatar's next move, suited to one situation; navigation has several such modes and the agent regulates movement by selecting the one its situation fits

attrs.name: navigation_mode_selection
attrs.definition: actively choose between navigation modes: each competing mode has an activation the current situation drives, and the agent selects the WINNER by argmax to gate behaviour; a winner-take-all competition that regulates which movement policy is active

attrs.name: frontier_seek
attrs.definition: navigation mode (the default explorer): head for the nearest unexplored reachable cell; its activation is high while the avatar makes progress, covering new ground each move

attrs.name: mover_avoid
attrs.definition: navigation mode (the patient one): when the reachable frontier churns because objects are moving, do not chase the fresh cells the movers vacate; hold the committed goal until movement settles; its activation is high when frontier flux is high

attrs.name: pocket_escape
attrs.definition: navigation mode (the prober): when confined with no new coverage for several moves, stop seeking the unreachable frontier; retry blocked directions and push for the region edge to break out; its activation is high when the no-progress count is high

attrs.name: coverage_progress
attrs.definition: situation signal: how many new cells the avatar covers per move; low progress means confinement

attrs.name: confinement
attrs.definition: situation signal: consecutive moves with no new coverage; the avatar is walled into a pocket

attrs.name: frontier_flux
attrs.definition: situation signal: how much the reachable frontier changes move to move because objects are moving
